    [OrderTopology α] {a b : α} (hab : a ≤ b) (f : α → α) 
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) 
    (h_image : Set.Icc a b ⊆ f '' (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = x := by
  have ha : a ∈ Set.Icc a b := (left_mem_Icc).mpr hab
  have ⟨s₀, hs₀_mem, hs₀_eq⟩ := h_image ha
  have hb : b ∈ Set.Icc a b := (right_mem_Icc).mpr hab
  have ⟨s₁, hs₁_mem, hs₁_eq⟩ := h_image hb
  have key := isPreconnected_Icc.intermediate_value₂ hs₀_mem hs₁_mem hf continuousOn_id
  have hs₀ : f s₀ ≤ s₀ := by rw [hs₀_eq]; exact hs₀_mem.1
  have hs₁ : s₁ ≤ f s₁ := by rw [hs₁_eq]; exact hs₁_mem.2
  exact key hs₀ hs₁
